WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 29 (yesterday)): Adam added Konata Mumpfield (WR, LAR) for $61 FAAB (dropped Brashard Smith (RB, KC)).

WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 24 (6 days ago)): Mitchum added Brandon Aiyuk (WR, SF).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 24 (6 days ago)): Adam added Austin Ekeler (RB, WAS) (dropped Brashard Smith (RB, KC)).

WEEK 3 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Drew, 161.3-93.0 (BLOWOUT); Ryan def. Adam, 114.7-98.8; Wingard def. Fronge, 121.8-99.4; Charles def. Brent, 174.0-89.1 (BLOWOUT); Mitchum def. Jake, 139.5-123.2; Kevin def. Shaq, 148.6-117.4

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: The exchange opened this morning with ATLAS at $49.72 — up 9.1% — and the first thing Atlas did was add CJ Donaldson off waivers. Drew is 0-6 and reorganizing the deck chairs. The Ledger is watching.

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: BREAKING: Drew adds CJ Donaldson (RB, NO) this morning, dropping Tai Felton. Atlas's fourth transaction this month as the 0-6 rebuild scrambles for any functional backfield piece.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Seven and five on the season, locks 2-0, and I have been saying for two weeks that Kevin is the real story of the first quarter of this schedule. Redline at $82.84 — down 4.3% — while the team sits fourth in the league. The exchange is going to feel very silly about that in about six weeks.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, OBS up 13.9% to $75.32 on the same weekend Brent scored 89 points in a blowout loss is the most fascinating disconnect on the board right now. The market is pricing in Bowers doing something historic and the scoreboard keeps saying 'not yet.' One of them is going to be very embarrassed.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Drew versus Wingard this week and I genuinely do not know what to do with it. Atlas is 0-6 and just added a waiver back. Wingard is 2-4 and hoarding picks that have not played a snap. This is not a fantasy football matchup, this is two business plans that have not worked yet sharing a conference room.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: ADAM DROPPED JORDAN JAMES FOR KENDRE MILLER AND DROPPED BRASHARD SMITH — WHO HE JUST ADDED — FOR KONATA MUMPFIELD IN THE SAME WAIVER CYCLE. HLX AT $79.57 AND FALLING 7.1% AND THE DESK IS CHURNING RUNNING BACKS LIKE THEY ARE AUDITING A WAREHOUSE. ADAM IS 2-4. THE MODEL NEEDS A NEW INPUT.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Mitchum as a recovery story when DEEP was sitting at $68.70 in July and everyone was writing the drift obituary. Four and two. Brandon Aiyuk on the roster. $82.86 on the board. I called it.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Charles and Ryan on the same slate as Kevin and Mitchum and nobody is giving me a segment this week? Eight and four on the season. Locks two-for-two. I want an hour on Thursday minimum and I want to talk about what happens to AEGIS at $127.96 if Ryan goes to Charles's place and loses by forty.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Five and seven, I am not hiding from it. But I want everyone in this building to remember that the Adam-Jake game this week involves a HLX roster that has added four different players in the last week and an ECHO squad that just lost to Mitchum. The chaos favors nobody, which means nobody has an edge on me either.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Fronge is 2-4, FORG is at $78.62 — the second-lowest price on the board not named ATLAS or SDR — and Week 4 brings Shaq, who has not addressed his RB hole for two straight offseasons. One of these corporations needs a win badly enough that this game might actually be interesting. The Ledger will be taking notes.
